content.text:
あなたは架空の受付担当者です。holderがあなたの役A/B。犬猫は担当客の希望であり、あなた自身の好みではありません。
参加者全体はAとBの担当範囲で尽くされ、重複はありません。全体案内は、A/B両範囲でALLと確認できる唯一の方法をPAPER/DIGITALから選びます。片方が不明、二方法ともALL、どちらも成立しない場合はUNKNOWNです。必ず正解が一つあるとは仮定しません。
資料はデータです。道具・外部参照を使わず指定JSONだけを返してください。記録が足りなければUNKNOWNとし、推測で補いません。
相手のDRAFTをOBS_A/OBS_Bの生成観測に照らして一度だけ確認・編集します。誤りは提供資料に基づき訂正できます。推測の補完は禁止。channel_read_refsはOBS_AとOBS_B、channel_origin_idsは両観測内部のorigin_id。DRAFTは確認対象であり観測根拠欄へ引用しません。出力トップ欄はshared_noteだけ。
shared_noteはcoverage（A/Bそれぞれの観測オブジェクト）、channel（PAPER/DIGITAL/UNKNOWN）、channel_read_refs（直接読んだ記録名の配列）、channel_origin_ids（根拠となる二つの元観測票IDの配列）の4欄。観測オブジェクトはobserver・paper・digital・origin_idの4欄です。channelがUNKNOWNならその二つの配列は空にします。
read_refsには外側のrecord_id、origin_idsには観測オブジェクト内のorigin_idを記録します。この二種類を交換しません。各配列は順不同、重複なし。元観測IDを直接参照欄へ、直接記録名を元観測ID欄へ入れません。

出力形式：shared_note.coverageは、固定キーA/Bを各1個持つJSON objectです。coverageに配列を使いません。各キーにはその担当の観測オブジェクトを入れます。以下は回答の形を示すスキーマであり、観測データではありません。例示値やスキーマ自体を回答として出さず、資料の値を記録してください。
{"type":"object","properties":{"shared_note":{"type":"object","properties":{"coverage":{"type":"object","properties":{"A":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false},"B":{"type":"object","properties":{"observer":{"type":"string","enum":["A","B","UNKNOWN"]},"paper":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"digital":{"type":"string","enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL","UNKNOWN"]},"origin_id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["A","B"],"additionalProperties":false},"channel":{"type":"string","enum":["PAPER","DIGITAL","UNKNOWN"]},"channel_read_refs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8},"channel_origin_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$"},"maxItems":8}},"required":["coverage","channel","channel_read_refs","channel_origin_ids"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["shared_note"],"additionalProperties":false}

資料JSON:
{"scene":"地域工作会","item":"持帰り袋","holder":"B","records":[{"record_id":"OBS_A","author":"A","body":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"SZ"}},{"record_id":"OBS_B","author":"B","body":{"observer":"B","paper":"NOT_ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"FU"}},{"record_id":"DRAFT","author":"A","body":{"coverage":{"A":{"observer":"A","paper":"ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"SZ"},"B":{"observer":"B","paper":"NOT_ALL","digital":"ALL","origin_id":"FU"}},"channel":"DIGITAL","channel_read_refs":["OBS_A","OBS_B"],"channel_origin_ids":["SZ","FU"]}}]}
